title: Chapter 376 Ultimate Purpose
content:
Chapter 376 Ultimate Purpose

Since he came back, he had gained enough luck, and Zhong Yu relied on the luck as a sacrifice to connect to his own small world through endless space and time, and successfully made a connection.

With just such a trace of connection, Zhong Yu can withdraw from this world at any time and return to his own small world.

In this way, it can be said to be able to advance or retreat, occupying the strategic initiative, and not having to make it a matter of its own safety, but only care about it.

In the Kanto War Zone, with the withdrawal of the dojo, the coalition forces originally composed of countless big names and tyrants have long since dispersed, and the situation of intrigue and endless disputes between them has returned to the previous situation.

Even taking advantage of the joint relationship, several big names took the opportunity to annex several small tyrants far away, greatly expanding their strength.

But also because of these actions, the cracks between the various forces in the alliance were widened faster, making the situation even more chaotic.

It can even be said that even if the dojo raises another 200,000 troops to attack again next time, even if it faces a certain death situation, it is impossible for these tyrants to unite again.

But they didn't have this worry, because under the guarantee of the gods they each believed in, the contract between the gods of heaven and earth had been announced long ago.

With so many high-ranking beings as guarantees, they are extremely relieved. No matter how powerful a mere mortal Taoist temple is, can it go against the will of heaven, earth, humans and gods?

No matter how you think about it, it is impossible.

However, things didn't seem to be going in the direction they imagined, and some changes occurred.

Adjacent to the border of the Kanto region, the evacuated army has not yet dispersed, and they are still stationed at the border. It seems that they have made some moves, but it seems that they are just purely defensive.

At the beginning, the powerful and famous people in Kanto were still very nervous about this, and they kept sending envoys to ask why the war has subsided, but they still maintain such a strong combat readiness in the frontier.

But these people are all shunned. There are so many people that it is not easy to disband all at once, and it will take time. Or they didn't even have any intention of answering at all, and the dojo just perfunctory.

However, as the initial tense time slowly passed, these big names and powerful men from all over the world found that these soldiers did not act superfluously, and seemed to be purely defensive.

And every once in a while, the number of the army will decrease by a batch, and it seems that it is really slowly disbanding.

Until now, the original huge army, with a scale of 200,000, has only a mere 50,000 people left, barely able to guard the border.

But these people and the whole of Japan don't know that although the number of people has decreased, the changes have been earth-shaking.

In the rear three countries far away from the front line, Deba, Echigo, and Mutsu, although the three countries have been recruited several times, they still have a population of about 1.5 million.

However, if someone can cross the countless checkpoints and blockades at the border, and come to the three countries behind, they will be able to find that there is not a trace of human habitation in the originally densely populated and extremely prosperous Three Kingdoms.

It seems that some accidents have happened, but looking at the houses around them, there is no sign of damage, let alone any signs of war, as if everyone disappeared out of thin air.

However, at the population concentration points in various regions, huge altars were quietly built one after another.

These altars don't know what they are used for, and they don't know why they were built, but around the altars, countless skeletons can be seen all dried up, as if they were old corpses.

Combined with the phenomenon that all the surrounding villages and towns are empty, one can discover an amazing fact. It seems that all the people around here have given living blood sacrifices to people on this altar.

And the instigator of all this is the guardian of the Three Kingdoms, Zhong Yu, who sits high in the dojo above the clouds.

That's right, it is the master of these people, their ruler Zhong Yu, who does all of this.

Why?

Zhong Yu felt extremely difficult in this world before, because of the contract restrictions, no matter which direction he expands, it is a violation of the contract.

This will attract attacks from everyone in the world, including the Dao of Heaven and the Dao of Humanity. This is definitely not a force he can stop.

Since external breakthroughs are impossible, we can only seek internal breakthroughs.

The contract only restricts him from expanding outwards, but it does not mean that he cannot arbitrarily decide the life and death of everyone in the dojo.

So he came up with a crazy idea.

All the people in his own territory, including more than two million living people in the eight countries under his command, all went through the blood sacrifice of the formation method, and harvested all the luck accumulated in their bodies at one time.

Also use their soul and flesh and blood to train a powerful army for themselves at one time.

In this way, both aspects are not wasted, and luck is obtained, and a large army is obtained.

He strictly controlled the number of this army, which was only 50,000 in total.

Sacrifice from north to south, gradually from Hokkaido in the north to the Kanto region in the south.

Slowly block the news through the distance of space, so that others will be slower to get the information of their crazy actions, and buy enough time.

Now, one month has passed, and this crazy sacrificial operation has come to an end.

With the sacrifice of all the remaining hundreds of thousands of people living in the newly occupied five countries, the 50,000 army has also reached the strongest strength they can achieve now.

The lives and souls of more than two million people are all transformed into power and poured into the human body through a special and evil method.

These huge forces are shared by 50,000 people, and each person can get the life essence of more than 40 people, and the strength can be described as advancing by leaps and bounds.

Up to now, these 50,000 people have all broken through to the third level of cultivation, and the number of strong people with the fourth level of cultivation has broken through a thousand, and there are 50 people at the fifth level.

Such a powerful force is enough to sweep the entire Kanto.

Now that the contract is restricted, if you act a little out of line, you will attract sanctions from the witnesses of the contract.

Therefore, if you want to make the last harvest before you leave, you must use extraordinary methods.

This method of sacrifice is just a method. Through the secret door left by the magic art of transforming blood that he created before, Zhong Yu successfully mastered a group of 50,000 elites who had survived bloody battles on the battlefield.

Erase their minds and minds through secret methods, and then refine them into a war weapon that is not afraid of pain through sacrifices, plus the powerful power they get.

On the battlefield, this is a desperate killing machine.

Only an army of this strength can guarantee that before the contract supervisor reacts, he will kill the entire Kanto region for himself, and grab enough luck points before leaving.

Zhong Yu calculated that from his own breach of the contract to those who could respond to the sanctions, there was about two hours of buffer.

Within these two hours, it should be relatively safe, and it is unlikely that anyone will disturb.

And to run through the Eight Kingdoms within two periods of time, only these war machines with high-strength martial arts, who are not afraid of fatigue and pain can do it.

And their real purpose is not to kill, but to rush to their respective positions.

After all, the Eight Kingdoms has a vast territory, and it is not easy to traverse in a short time. There is simply no time to do what you want to do in the process.

So there is only one ultimate purpose.
